analysis_status: post-effort-audit ecological association using a binomial 5-min-census incidence response; not ecological rewiring

candidate_surface.plant: focal plant has identifiable 5-min censuses in both adjacent subseasons
candidate_surface.pollinator: focal pollinator is independently detected on at least one other plant in both adjacent subseasons

ecological_read.supported: After putting focal-plant census count into the response denominator, current focal-response-excluded site-week opportunity has a small positive pooled association with interaction incidence.
ecological_read.not_supported: The opportunity increment is not reproducibly positive across all six held-out subseason transitions under the frozen rule, so it cannot be promoted as a general within-season ecological filter result.
ecological_read.consequence: The effort-standardized response weakens the apparent universality of the binary-turnover opportunity signal.

claim_ceiling: Effort-standardized observed interaction-incidence association only. The pooled opportunity increment is small and fold-mixed; do not use this result as evidence for general ecological rewiring or routeability.
